messages:
sara: Heads-up — planning a short rolling soft-reboot of GPU nodes in us-west2 and eu-central next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. Affects preemptible and dedicated pools (cohorts). Minimal, staggered cohorts to keep tail latency SLOs.

mike-infra: What's the impact on Dedicated tenants? Any forced evictions?

sara: No forced evictions for high-priority dedicated pools. We'll drain low-priority preemptible cohorts only. Dedicated customers on reserved capacity will be routed to secondary pools; fallback policy enabled.

jen: Can we run a 0.5% canary in us-west2 first? Want to validate nvlink stability.

sara: Yes — canary cohort = 4 nodes (0.5%), run at 02:00 for 15m. If CPU/GPU error-rate < 0.1% continue.

kevin: Cost note — backfill with spot instances will increase network egress and short-term instance spend. Expected short-term cost delta ~ $1.2k across the window. Confirmed with finance.

lina: Oncall: please watch ipc_errors, nvlink_restores, and kvcache-miss spikes. Alert thresholds adjusted in pagerduty runbook.

oncall-bot: Alert policy update deployed: ipc_errors >= 5/m => P1. nvlink_restores >= 3/m => P2.

phil: One more ask — switch routing policy to prefer eu-central replicas for traffic during eu maintenance. Runbook snippet:

````
# temporary routing
rbac set route-preference --region eu-central --weight 0.8 --until 05:30Z
````

sara: Will push the routing change at 01:50 so connections stabilize. We'll also enable automatic rollback at 05:40.

mike-infra: How about prefix cache warmup? Do we need manual pre-warm?

sara: We'll pre-warm kv cache for model-serving paths with the warmup job (runs 01:30-01:50). Job snippet:

````
k8s job apply warmup-gpu-kv 
  --labels=maintenance=soft-reboot 
  --concurrency=10 
  --promptset=small-hotset
````

jen: TL;DR: canary 02:00 x15m, staggered 5-min drains, warmup before, routing pref to region replicas, watch ipc/nvlink/kvcache, cost ~ $1.2k.

kevin: Approved from finance. :thumbsup: 

sara: Okay — posting to #announcements and emailing top-tier Dedicated customers. Will update this thread with live status during ops.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: maintenance/soft-reboot-2026-03-24 at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z
